title: Create trycmd tests for flow command
description:
Flow CLI integration tests, current state (2026-10-06). The flag/error surface and this loan's fixture groundwork are merged; the remaining scenario coverage is tracked in a follow-up pebble.

Merged:
- tests/cmd/flow-flags.trycmd: flow flag surface (--format text default; --output required for svg/json/dot; --show-done; --goal), the text layout contract (Layer N headers, indicator glyphs, 30-char truncation, standalone section), and the non-text-without--output error.
- tests/workflows/flow-goal.trycmd with the flow-goal.in fixture stores: goal error cases (unknown goal ID, goal with no path to any root, done goal hidden without --show-done).
- tests/workflows/flow-patterns.in: six graph-shape fixture stores (chain, diamond, disconnected, fan-in, fan-out, mixed) built for this loan.
- flow.rs unit tests: cycle and self-cycle rejection, empty-store layout, SVG/XML escaping, DOT empty output.

Remaining (moved to 99a7f1dd): shape-based trycmd layout tests over flow-patterns.in, SVG/JSON/DOT structure assertions, empty-store and cycle-error trycmd scenarios.
